'''2000 Washington State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Washington in spring 2000. [[Joe Olson]] posted both decks he played there: his Dark deck went 3–0 and his Light deck 2–1. He later wrote that he used the Light deck "to win WA States".<ref name="dt-6354">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6354 The Deck From Heck v2 1], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 5 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6354/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6354/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="dt-5876">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5876 Washington State Champs DS Deck- ISB ORS], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 23 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5876/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5876/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="dt-5875">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5875 WA State Champs LS Deck- Juz s Revenge], DeckTech (Joe "arebelspy" Olson, 23 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5875/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5875/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 22 April 2000<ref name="tr-d588" />
* '''Site:''' Washington; Wizards of the Coast Game Center, Seattle, Washington<ref name="tr-d588" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Players:''' 44–46<ref name="tr-d588" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Washington State Championship Joe Olson Washington State Champs DS Deck- ISB ORS]] ([[Joe Olson]], [[Dark]]; 3–0) — "Went 3-0 at Washington States"
* [[2000 Washington State Championship Joe Olson WA State Champs LS Deck- Juz s Revenge]] ([[Joe Olson]], [[Light]]; 2–1) — "Went 2-1 at the Washington State Championships"
* [[Joe Olson The Deck From Heck v2 1]] ([[Joe Olson]], [[Light]]) — a later post, filed as a general deck: the description says it is "the Deck that I used to win WA States, only updated"

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Joe Olson Washington State Championships Long (tournament report)]] — by [[Joe Olson]], 1st, 5–1
* [[Charles Hickey Washington States (tournament report)]] — by [[Charles Hickey]], 5th, 5–1
* [[Derek Snook Washington States 4-22 Food (tournament report)]] — by [[Derek Snook]], 9th, 4–2
* [[Greg Otte WA State Championship Seattle 04-26-2000 (tournament report)]] — by [[Greg Otte]], 0–6

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Derek Snook says Charles Hickey got a timed loss in his last game, slowed by reading Trample, which cost him 2nd place; Hickey's own report records a timed win by 15 over Nick Jones, says it was Jones who stalled and read Trample, and puts himself 5th.<ref name="tr-d612" />
* Greg Otte's report title dates the event 04-26-2000; the hub and Joe Olson's and Derek Snook's reports give 22 April 2000.<ref name="tr-d855" />
